description: This file is a shell script configuring and managing the MBIM (Mobile Broadband Interface Model) protocol for network interfaces in a Linux-based system, likely used within OpenWrt or similar firmware. It contains functions for initializing configurations, setting up and tearing down network connections, interacting with the umbim utility to communicate with the modem, and managing network interface parameters.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the MBIM protocol configuration parameters and adds necessary configuration options.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Parses the provided MBIM configuration string to extract the value corresponding to a specified field.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Sets up the MBIM network connection by interacting with the modem device, performing PIN entry, registration, and network configuration.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls _proto_mbim_setup and handles retries if setup fails.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the MBIM network connection, disconnects from the modem, and updates the network state.
